source_interface: source measurements only; direct_income_net_bn remains mixed labor/capital

transport_to_2024.rule: caller must state frozen-nominal or another sourced scaling arm; no automatic inflation or growth

income_definition.s_corporation: ordinary net income minus (total receipts-business receipts). Removes all other receipts and noncapital gains, including upstream receipts/gains; also subtracts tax-exempt interest already excluded from ordinary net, a deliberate conservative under-sizing arm. Upstream losses remain deducted. Exact business-receipts-minus-deductions residual unavailable in finance: deductions and tax-exempt interest suppressed
income_definition.partnership: ordinary net business income less ordinary income from other partnerships/fiduciaries plus ordinary losses from those entities; excludes portfolio/rental lines
income_definition.sole_proprietor: Schedule C net income less deficit; excludes Schedule F farm proprietors; proprietor labor remains in profit

capital_identification: economic owner labor, normal return, source geography and ultimate taxable ownership are not identified; no central capital fraction or normal-return share
ownership_warning: partnership allocations are total Schedule K income less deductions by immediate partner type, NOT direct ordinary-profit ownership shares; ratios can be negative or exceed 1
